_doc: Tuning knobs for the unified improvement Routine (prompts/routine2.md). Edit weights, nudges, and openrouter caps here. 'enabled_modes' controls which modes the selector may pick. systemic-fix self-suppresses when planning/wiki/ideas/backlog-queue.json has no open batch-ready item; candidates self-suppresses while candidate_words.json holds >= candidate_restock_threshold words, so it only claims runs when the queue needs restocking. See enhancement/routine2-plan-2026-06-10.md.
